array_comparison: Exact dtype, shape and per-entry bytes, including signed zero and NaN payloads; no tolerance or filled observations.

reconstruction.inflation: Previous post-audit stock plus each due wash commitment in decision order, bounded by high minus archived current goodness; selected positive stock clears after trading.
reconstruction.signal: Pre-audit stock for immutable trading signal; post-audit stock for planning; identical replayed daily error. Public snapshot observed at a is used on a+1 through a+D only.
reconstruction.error: Independent replay of SeedSequence([seed,1]).spawn(4)[3]; all days including day0 and sigma0 consume n_firms standard normals.
reconstruction.initial_state: Initial true goodness and inflation are conditioned on the archived day0 state; subsequent real changes and decay are reconstructed.
reconstruction.source: Only archived inputs, arrays and source bytes are read. No simulation, NPV or market/statistical re-estimation is invoked.

limitations: Three development seeds per scenario, not the 30-seed confirmatory requirement.
Mechanism PASS cannot override market FAIL or pending empirical calibration.
Independent error replay verifies the recorded noise process, not its empirical realism.
Disclosure delay changes new inflated-report projects only; reporting frequency and private investor signals are not modeled.
